This role is responsible for coordinating international assignments and relocations, managing immigration and work authorization requirements , and drafting, reviewing, and coordinating employment contracts in compliance with applicable local labor laws and company policies. The ideal candidate is fluent in Arabic and English and can manage mobility and contract-related matters with limited oversight while partnering closely with HR, Legal, business leaders, and external service providers. Manage the end-to-end global mobility process, including international relocations, assignments, transfers, and repatriation. Conduct initial case intake and policy eligibility reviews, identify required services and documentation, and initiate cases with the appropriate internal teams and external providers. Coordinate visa applications, work permits, residency permits, and other immigration-related requirements in partnership with internal teams and external immigration providers. Monitor immigration status and document-expiry dates, track application progress, anticipate potential challenges and delays, and proactively resolve issues to ensure timely processing and excellent employee experience. Ensure compliance with applicable immigration laws, local regulations, and company policies across relevant Middle Eastern jurisdictions. Maintain accurate employee mobility records, assignment documentation, immigration status updates, and relevant reporting. Provide regular updates and reporting on mobility cases, immigration status, timelines, and potential compliance risks. Support immigration and mobility audits by maintaining appropriate records, responding to information requests and assisting with remediation actions. Identify and escalate complex, non-standard or higher-risk matters to Global Mobility leadership, Legal, Tax, Payroll or external advisers, as appropriate. Escalate actual or potential non-compliance promptly, including unauthorised work, missed filing or renewal deadlines, inconsistent documentation and deviations from approved policy or process. Support continuous improvement of Global Mobility processes, employee communications, templates, guidance materials and reporting. Handle personal, immigration and employment information confidentially and in accordance with applicable data-protection requirements and company policies. Ensure employment contracts are aligned with applicable local labor laws, regulatory requirements, and company policies. Prepare and review employment documentation in Arabic and English, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and appropriate legal terminology. Serve as a key contact for employment contract inquiries, providing guidance to HR teams and relevant stakeholders on contractual documentation and processes.
